system.description:
You generate a stream of Data release which flows into technological objects, allowing you to take wrestle control of them from their rightful owners.

All sufficiently technological items within range (Computers, radio links, data scrolls, electronic doors, etc.) fall under your jutsu’s effects while they remain in the affected area, allowing you to make a Ninshou check vs a DC 20 (with the GM being able to increase the DC based on circumstance, by up to +10).

On a success, you are able to gain control of these systems, for the next minute telepathically. You can activate, deactivate, and read the contents and communications occurring within the systems simultaneously. If the system you have access to as a result of this jutsu is connected to other systems such as security, life support, surveillance, doors, etc., you also gain access to these systems and can turn them off or isolate them preventing others from accessing them for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, increase the duration to 1 Hour, and you the systems no longer need to be within this jutsu’s area of effect to manipulate. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the duration to 24hrs.
